name: kohi-fixmath
description: Permissive (MIT) Q31.32 fixed-point math (Fix64 / Trig256 / SinLut256). It is standalone, so downstream units link to it and do not inline it. The LGPL noise and the KVM use it as their base.

scripts.vet: npm run goldens && npm run check:ts && npm run check:rust && npm run check:bytecode && forge test && npm run fork-verify
